## ProofsModule.proposeProof() method

Initiate a new presentation exchange as prover by sending a presentation proposal message to the connection with the specified connection id.

<b>Signature:</b>

```typescript
proposeProof(connectionId: string, presentationProposal: PresentationPreview, config?: {
        comment?: string;
        autoAcceptProof?: AutoAcceptProof;
    }): Promise<ProofRecord>;
```

## Parameters

|  Parameter | Type | Description |
|  --- | --- | --- |
|  connectionId | string | The connection to send the proof proposal to |
|  presentationProposal | [PresentationPreview](./core.presentationpreview.md) | The presentation proposal to include in the message |
|  config | { comment?: string; autoAcceptProof?: [AutoAcceptProof](./core.autoacceptproof.md)<!-- -->; } | <i>(Optional)</i> Additional configuration to use for the proposal |
